H02.description: The executable-target regex omits workflow files, makefiles, justfiles, package manifests, Dockerfiles and CI/pre-commit configs, so a heredoc writing destructive content into them is classified non-executing and its body is not scanned.

H05.description: Backtick command substitutions are never normalised, so no rule anchors on them and `echo "see `git push --force origin main`"` (or an unquoted heredoc body with backticks) passes the fence while its $( ) twin blocks.

H14.description: allowed-tools lacks `Bash(.claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh knob *)`, so the skill's postlude knob read (deny_raw_shell) is refused.

H20.description: The example pins a profile-governed key explicitly, so a copied example overrides loa.profile and choosing lean/full has no effect on it.

H56.description: The knob-reader lint escapes only dots, misses reads split across a yq pipe or bracket form, and swallows grep errors (2>/dev/null, || true) so a bad pattern or missing tools/ dir reads as a clean pass.
